html:
SMTO-WEB-0025 — The answer used a fact SMTO's research doesn't contain

GUID: 229916c6-662d-59cc-97b4-f2daed76794b
Slug: research-unknown-fact-reference
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • Part of the answer refers to an item or detail that isn't in the research SMTO gathered. SMTO won't swap in a different fact on its own.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait for the run to finish. SMTO sends the answer back to the Model and asks it to use only items and details from this run's research. The Model referred to something outside the research, which it can usually fix on another pass.
  2. If the run stops and a detail is missing, ask SMTO to look up that specific detail, naming the item. A new lookup adds the missing fact to the research so the answer can use it.
  3. If the run stops and an unchecked answer is acceptable to you, open the Research proof validation card shown in the run and turn off Enforce this check for this run. This shows the answer without confirming each detail came from the research.

What success looks like

  • The answer appears and each detail is linked to a page SMTO read.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't accept an answer that quietly replaces the detail you asked about with a different one.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Research proof rejected a claim whose subject_id is not in research.subjects or whose fact_ids include an ID absent from research.facts.

What this means

  • Claim selection names a subject or fact absent from the research maps. This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.

Why this can happen

  • Claim selection names a subject or fact absent from the research maps.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare subject_id and fact_ids with current packet references.

How to fix it

  • Raised as research_unknown_fact_reference in selected_facts. The claim map must reference subject and fact IDs from the current research packet; use existing references or omit the claim rather than substituting another fact.
  • Use current subject and fact references or omit the unsupported result.

Retry and execution caution

  • Use verified facts or an explicit scoped limitation.

How to verify the fix

  • Every selected subject and fact belongs to the retained research state.

What not to do

  • Do not invent a fact identifier or silently substitute a different fact.

Technical notes

  • This is an opt-in research proof check. With enforcement disabled the runtime retains the answer; observation mode can record a fault without blocking it. Rejected proof does not erase completed source access or authorize another acquisition.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
